response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer with deep open-source and Linux experience, but he falls short on two critical requirements: German proficiency (self-reported 'Basic' vs. required C1) and demonstrated leadership/team-management experience. His career is almost entirely individual-contributor roles, with no evidence of managing teams, client advisory work at an architectural level, or operational project oversight expected of a Head of Development. Without C1 German, he cannot fulfill the client-facing consulting responsibilities of this role.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across web, mobile, embedded, and high-performance systems
Strong open-source commitment (GISCollective founder, DLang libraries, FOSS4G speaker) and Linux background
Mentoring inclination shown through workshops, courses, and code katas
concerns: German is only 'Basic', far below the required C1 minimum
No formal team leadership, people management, or executive-level experience
Limited evidence of UML, requirements management, or IT security/compliance expertise
